fda.text: CONTRAINDICATIONS AND WARNINGS Isotretinoin capsules must not be used by patients who are or may become pregnant. There is an extremely high risk that life-threatening birth defects will result if pregnancy occurs while taking isotretinoin capsules in any amount, even for short periods of time. Psychiatric Disorders Isotretinoin capsules may cause depression, psychosis and, rarely, suicidal ideation, suicide attempts, suicide, and aggressive and/or violent behaviors. summary: Isotretinoin carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest safety alert from the FDA, because taking it during pregnancy poses an extremely high risk of life-threatening birth defects [3][5]. The drug's label also warns that it may cause mental health issues such as depression, psychosis, aggressive behaviors, and rarely suicidal thoughts or actions [5]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received low risk scores for both liver and heart issues [M].
